title: Water-soluble ZnPc(COOH)4/Ch/MgO self-assembled systems
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,11115-11120
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01256B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tamara Potlog, Ion Lungu, Mariana Diru, Alexandrina Druta, Marius Dobromir
We report a water soluble MgO/Ch/ZnPc(COOH)4 self-assembled room-temperature phosphorescent material with unique performance, such as a long lifetime of 5.01 μs, large Stokes shift of 105 nm and a phosphorescence quantum yield of 10.63%.
